faq.title: Clinical and platform support
faq.lead: What CDS is, how a consult flows, species coverage, security, and veterinary access — written so a practicing vet can understand the tool before using it.
faq.moreLead: The help center lives in Doctor Plumitas chat: guides by module (consult, CDS, records, schedule, inventory, and more).
faq.empty: Frequently asked questions are unavailable right now.

a: CDS means Clinical Decision Support. In GUIAA it is not an “automatic diagnosis” and it does not replace your judgment: it is a structured workflow that helps you organize case information — chief complaint, history, physical exam, findings, and documentation — so you can reason more clearly and leave traceable records.
The goal is fewer omissions, species-adapted capture, and a clinical record that is useful for the next visit, referral, or follow-up. You decide the diagnosis, the plan, and what gets documented.

items.q: What are CDS L4 and L5?
a: They are depth levels of clinical support within the same consult. L4 focuses on structuring diagnostic reasoning: organizing signs, history, and findings so differential hypotheses are clear and reviewable.

L5 moves toward the plan: therapeutic and follow-up guidance documented from what you captured in the consult, always as support — not as a closed order. In both levels the final decision is yours as the responsible veterinarian.

items.q: What does a CDS consult look like?
a: You select or register the patient and species. You complete chief complaint, signs, and physical exam with adapted forms. Then you move through CDS support (L4/L5) to organize hypotheses and plan, and save the consult.
It lands in History and on the patient chart. You can reopen cases, export PDF when needed, and connect clinical activity with the rest of the practice (schedule, records, lab).
Only licensed veterinarians. During registration we verify your professional license or registration to keep a clinical-only environment among colleagues.
Pet owners do not use the clinical panel: they have a separate portal for appointment requests or guidance depending on what your clinic offers.

items.q: Do I get trial CDS consultations when I register?
a: Yes. When you create your veterinarian account you receive 3 trial CDS consultations to walk through the full clinical flow with a real or practice case.
Then you choose a plan (Basic, Professional, or Premium) based on consult volume and modules: records, schedule, inventory, sales, reports, lab, and Expert Mode.
It unites history-taking, physical exam, and CDS L4·L5 support in one clinical flow, with species-specific forms and traceable records — not scattered notes or human-medicine templates.
It is built for veterinary practice in Latin America: daily work, follow-up, and professional documentation, always under your clinical judgment.

items.q: Which species does the platform cover?
a: Dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, reptiles, ferrets, hedgehogs, hamsters, guinea pigs, iguanas, and poultry, among other clinical profiles available.
Each species unlocks adapted fields and sections (signs, exam, history) so you are not forced into a single “dog” form for non-conventional species.
Records and consultations are tied to your professional account with access controls. We apply security and privacy practices oriented to clinical use.
Your clinic can invite the team with roles (for example reception or veterinarian) without sharing your password. Legal detail is in the platform notices and terms.

items.q: Can I use it in-clinic and on house calls?
items.a: Yes. It is a web platform: it works in a fixed clinic or on external visits from a laptop or tablet with a modern browser and internet. It does not replace hands-on clinical work; it organizes and documents what you capture in the case.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. You sign in from the browser with your verified veterinarian account. We recommend an up-to-date browser and a stable connection, especially when exporting PDF or working with lab interpretations.

items.q: Where is the full help center?
items.a: In Doctor Plumitas chat (Help tab) you will find guides by module: getting started, what CDS is, diagnostic consult, owners and pets, schedule, inventory, sales, reports, history, lab, membership, and shortcuts. You can also replay the welcome tour from Settings.
